chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
When you hear a tradition, grasp it with the grasp of careful preservation, not merely the grasp of transmission; for the relaters of knowledge are many, but its guardians are few.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between riwayah and ri'ayah in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) distinguishes between *riwayah* (mechanical transmission) and *ri'ayah* (careful preservation and understanding), urging believers to internalize knowledge rather than merely repeating it. This hadith underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on critical evaluation (*ta'dil*) and deep comprehension (*fiqh*) over simple narration, ensuring that the few true guardians of wisdom preserve the essence of the message amidst the multitude of mere transmitters.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 98. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
When you hear a tradition test it according to the criterion of intelligence not that of mere hearing, because relaters of knowledge are numerous but those who guard it are few.
